cue: Initial transistor-level topology for TLV271 proposed by EDAI (FLAN-T5 + rules: ['상보 뒤집기', '캐스코드'])
lesson: Start from blueprint 'EDAI_TLV271': GF180MCU 6V transistor-level op-amp sized by gm/ID (ngspice pre-check 4/5 specs). Keep the .include model line; devices use nfet_06v0_bsim0 / pfet_06v0_bsim0.

evidence.table: NM1 D=VB1 G=VB1 S=VSS B=VSS ; NM2 D=VB2 G=VB2 S=VSS B=VSS ; NM3 D=OUT G=N1 S=VSS B=VSS ; NM4 D=N2 G=VB2 S=VSS B=VSS ; NM5 D=N1_NM5 G=N3 S=VSS B=VSS ; NM6 D=N3_NM6 G=N3 S=VSS B=VSS ; NM7 D=N4 G=N5 S=VSS B=VSS ; NM8 D=N5 G=N5 S=VSS B=VSS ; PM1 D=OUT G=N4 S=VDD B=VDD ; PM2 D=VB1 G=N4 S=VDD B=VDD ; PM3 D=N1 G=IN1 S=N6 B=VDD ; PM4 D=N3 G=IN2 S=N6 B=VDD ; PM5 D=N6 G=N4 S=VDD B=VDD ; PM6 D=N4 G=N4 S=VDD B=VDD ; PM7 D=N5 G=N2 S=VDD B=VDD ; PM8 D=N2 G=N2 S=VDD B=VDD ; PM9 D=VB2 G=N2 S=N7 B=VDD ; R1 P=N7 N=VDD ; NMC1 D=N1 G=VBCN S=N1_NM5 B=VSS ; NMC2 D=N3 G=VBCN S=N3_NM6 B=VSS
